summary: Bitcoin has been stuck in a choppy range around $20K since June 2022 with multiple tests of $19K support that are getting weaker over time. Both Cred and Trader Maine agree short-term trading is difficult due to low volatility, but long-term value exists for BTC in the $10K-$20K range and for ETH in the $600-$1100 range if holding for 12-36 months. Macro conditions with Fed tightening suggest more downside pressure likely before eventual bull market, with Cred expecting BTC to eventually trade below June's low of $17.5K. Both see reclaiming previous all-time highs (20K for BTC, 1400 for ETH) as key bullish signals.
